name: SkipLink
purpose: Let keyboard and assistive-technology users bypass repeated page navigation and move focus to main content.
useWhen: A page repeats navigation or controls before its main content.

avoidWhen.condition: There is no repeated content before the primary content target.

composition: Place Root near the beginning of the page and provide one matching Target id at main content.

rules.statement: Keep Root href and Target id identical and unique.
Make Root the first useful focus target when it bypasses repeated navigation.

commonMistakes.mistake: Linking to a missing id or adding a second main landmark around Target.
commonMistakes.correction: Use one matching Target as the page's main landmark.

validation: Tab from the browser chrome, activate Root, and confirm Target receives visible focus and scrolls into view.
Confirm the document contains one main landmark.
